items.title: Smart home devices should work without the internet
items.summary: Rule one is that nothing in my house needs a vendor
items.titleZh: 智能家居设备不该依赖互联网运行
items.summaryZh: 第一条原则是：我家里的任何东西都不需要依赖供应商。

items.title: Scion is back and is going to sell a kei truck in America
items.summary: Toyota's Scion is back and this time it's weird. The new Scion is going to sell a Kei truck in America, plus a bike and a hybrid side-by-side
items.titleZh: Scion 回归，将在美国销售一款超迷你的轻型卡车
items.summaryZh: 丰田旗下 Scion 回来了，这次的产品相当特别：它将在美国销售一款轻型卡车，还会推出一辆自行车和一款混合动力并排座越野车。

items.title: .name Grandfathered
items.summary: After a long and expensive battle, news just dropped that Verisign is retracting its plan to terminate 22,000 domain names and email redirects. Although they will be closing new registrations for 3rd-level .name domains,…

items.title: Starlink Mini 2
items.summary: Starlink delivers fast, reliable internet at home and on the go. Seamlessly stream, video call, game and more with high-speed connectivity even in the most rural and remote places.
items.summaryZh: Starlink 为家庭和外出场景提供快速、可靠的互联网服务。即使身处偏远乡村，也能通过高速连接顺畅观看流媒体、视频通话、玩游戏等。

items.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
items.summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.
items.titleZh: OpenAI 收购由 Sonder 创始人创办的旅游初创公司 Odessia
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 尚未透露其未来在旅游领域的计划。不过，Sonder 创始人 Francis Davidson 是旅游行业的知名人士。

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
items.titleZh: 纽约 AI 安全法生效，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 将面临新的监管
items.summaryZh: 纽约正准备执行全面的 AI 安全法，要求 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等大型开发商登记、披露安全措施并报告重大事故，否则将面临罚款。

items.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
items.summary: Former SignalFire investor Sahir Raoof raises $27.5 million for new fund targeting AI in pharma.
items.titleZh: Proximal Ventures 募集首支基金，投资将 AI 引入药物研发的初创公司
items.summaryZh: 前 SignalFire 投资人 Sahir Raoof 为新基金募集了 2,750 万美元，重点投资将 AI 应用于制药领域的项目。

items.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
items.summary: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of…
items.titleZh: Anthropic 七位创始人将在 IPO 中各自套现约 2.5 亿美元
items.summaryZh: 七位联合创始人计划在 IPO 中出售完全相同数量的股份。按发行价区间中位数计算，每人将获得约 2.5 亿美元现金，同时创始团队仍将保持控制权……

items.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
items.summary: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”
items.titleZh: Oura 将以 6.25 亿美元收购 AI 原生初级医疗保健初创公司 Counsel Health
items.summaryZh: 几周前，Oura 以 IPO 市场存在“不确定性”为由，无限期推迟了最高达 22 亿美元的 IPO 计划。

items.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
items.summary: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.
items.titleZh: PSI 正试图将 AI 驱动的科学发现转化为商业模式
items.summaryZh: PSI 使用 Anthropic 尚未发布的模型，回答了一个关于量子计算的基础问题。科学家们为此已探索近二十年。

items.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
items.summary: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.
items.titleZh: OpenAI 推出企业资料页，让 ChatGPT 更像 Google
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 希望将 ChatGPT 打造成更强大的消费信息发现引擎，而一系列新功能旨在帮助企业推动这一目标。
